items.author: speckx

items.title: Tell HN: I hate your fuzzy search
items.titleZh: 告诉 HN：我讨厌你的模糊搜索
items.summary:
Not just HN the site, everyone’s fuzzy search sucks. Let me do exact match search. Even if it’s an option I have to dig deep to find. When I ran a site that had lots of search use I agonized over making search good and never nuked exact match for the sake of some fuzzy matching. I wish others would do the same.

 Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49136990

 Points: 21

 # Comments: 10
items.summaryZh:
不仅仅是 HN 这个网站，每个人的模糊搜索都很糟糕。让我进行精确匹配搜索。即使这是一个选择，我也必须深入挖掘才能找到。当我运行一个有大量搜索使用的网站时，我为如何使搜索变得更好而苦恼，并且从不为了某些模糊匹配而取消精确匹配。我希望其他人也能这样做。
